architecturalPatterns.name: Database Schema Sharing (SSOT)
architecturalPatterns.purpose: Isolate schema.prisma, PostgreSQL migrations, and compile the Prisma Client within a shared package ('sneakyskink-bdd') to prevent duplicate schemas across all microservices.

architecturalPatterns.name: Adapter Pattern
architecturalPatterns.purpose: Decouple game versions (BB3, WBB) from the internal database schema by parsing external JSON data into standard domain interfaces before database operations.

architecturalPatterns.name: Token Bucket / Cooldown Key Rotation
architecturalPatterns.purpose: Distribute traffic dynamically across multiple BB3 API keys, keeping track of calls per minute per key, putting keys in quarantined cooldown upon HTTP 429 errors.

architecturalPatterns.name: Priority Queue-based Scraping
architecturalPatterns.purpose: Structure harvesting tasks into Priority 1 (Live/End Match), Priority 2 (Regular League Update), and Priority 3 (Historical Archive Ingestion) using BullMQ.

architecturalPatterns.name: Exponential Backoff & Recovery
architecturalPatterns.purpose: Pause all scraping queues and retry with exponentially increasing delays when hitting server-wide downtime or network failures (HTTP 500/503).

codeGuidelines.typescript: Strict typing, no use of 'any', explicit return types for services and functions.
codeGuidelines.logging: Structured logging only via the Pino instance in src/utils/logger.ts, avoiding console.log.
codeGuidelines.database: Database schema changes must only happen in the shared sneakyskink-bdd repository, avoiding local schema duplicates. Harvester uses client exports directly from 'sneakyskink-bdd'.
